## Lane
- [ ] Page protections  - [ ] Interface  - [ ] Network  - [ ] Other

## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run lint` pass with no new warnings
- [ ] Tried it in Firefox (loaded `dist/manifest.json`)
- [ ] New or changed protection: test page case added or updated in `tests/pages/`
- [ ] `docs/COVERAGE.md` row added or updated (nothing marked Verified without checking)
- [ ] `docs/modules/<name>.md` added or updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` line added under Unreleased
- [ ] `docs/STATUS.md` updated if the project state changed
- [ ] No `console.*` in page-world code, no full URLs stored, no network requests
- [ ] Big or hard-to-reverse choice? Added a note in `docs/decisions/`
